lore.subject: public/consent.html
lore.fact: Manufacturing Consent (public/consent.html) is a pixel factory hero (js/consent-factory.js) above eight production lines: Media, War & Money, Bought Movements, Faith Weaponized, Faith With Workers, The Dream Factory (Hollywood), Paid to Post (influencers, with a J.P. Morgan/Titanic myth-versus-record panel) and How To Spot It.

lore.subject: public/js/consent-factory.js
lore.fact: js/consent-factory.js crawls window.FACTORY_LINES on its billboard; consent.html sets that list from each case's tv field, so adding a tv line to a case adds it to the billboard.

lore.subject: research/consent-hollywood-influencers-sources.json
lore.fact: research/consent-hollywood-influencers-sources.json holds the verified Hollywood and influencer facts for consent.html with their quotes, plus each accepted near-miss and edited line with its reason.

traces.prompt: Redesign a Find Aliens page whose layout the user hates, keeping every verified case

steps.result: list every block the page carries (data arrays, stat tiles, quote bands, panels, filters, checklists) so the new layout drops none of it
one pixel-art hero that states the page's idea in a picture, prototyped on its own page and judged from screenshots before the layout is touched
a fresh stylesheet, not overrides on the old one: an index of sections, a sticky rail on desktop, two-up cards with a status bar, a single list on phones; same data placeholders

steps.args: node shot.js <page> at 1440 and 390, sections via --eval with scrollBehavior auto
steps.result: found a pixel title overrunning its grid column, a cramped phone legend and odd-card holes; fixed each and shot again
